fact: The director of the Centre national de calcul said on 30 July 2025 that the centre hosts a supercomputer and that startups will get accounts to use its computing resources remotely through the AI hub; GPUs could be added later.
title: Kouassi Benjamin (Dir. CNC de Côte d’Ivoire) : « Le supercalculateur est la rampe de lancement de la stratégie nationale IA »
